items.exampleEn: Divers found gold coins inside a shipwreck at the bottom of the sea.
items.exampleZh: 潛水員在海底一艘沉船裡找到了金幣。

items.exampleEn: The frigate sailed ahead of the other ships to watch for danger.
items.exampleZh: 巡防艦駛在其他船隻前方，留意有沒有危險。

items.exampleEn: The captain studied the map to find a deep anchorage for the large ship.
items.exampleZh: 船長研究地圖，替那艘大船找一個水深的停泊處。

items.exampleEn: The motorbike is parked under a tree in front of the shop.
items.exampleZh: 那台摩托車停在店門口的一棵樹下。

items.exampleEn: Neighbors put up signs asking speeders to slow down near the school.
items.exampleZh: 鄰居們在學校附近立起告示，請超速的駕駛人減速。

items.exampleEn: The ferryboat was painted bright yellow so other ships could see it easily.
items.exampleZh: 那艘渡船漆成亮黃色，讓其他船容易看見。

items.exampleEn: The aircrew checked every seat before the plane landed.
items.exampleZh: 飛機降落前，機組人員檢查了每個座位。

items.exampleEn: The mayor went on a walkabout in the market to talk with shoppers.
items.exampleZh: 市長在市場走動，和買菜的民眾聊天。
items.glossZh: （名人在人群中的）走動；徒步遊

items.sentenceEn: The police stopped three speeders on the highway this morning.
items.sentenceZh: 今天早上警察在高速公路上攔下了三個超速的駕駛人。

items.audioEn: The last ferryboat to the island leaves at nine, so please don't be late.
items.audioZh: 開往島上的最後一班渡船九點開，請不要遲到。

items.sentenceEn: The aircrew members wore dark blue uniforms with gold wings.
items.sentenceZh: 機組人員穿著繡有金色翅膀的深藍色制服。

items.sentenceEn: He sold his car and now rides a motorbike to save money.
items.sentenceZh: 他把車賣了，現在騎摩托車來省錢。

items.stemEn: The museum tells the story of a famous ____ that sank in a storm two hundred years ago.
items.stemZh: 博物館講述兩百年前一艘在暴風雨中沉沒的知名巡防艦的故事。

items.stemEn: The small fishing boats waited in the ____ until the wind died down.
items.stemZh: 小漁船在停泊處等到風勢減弱。

items.passageEn: Last summer, our family spent a week on a small island. We arrived at the island's dock on an old ferryboat that also carried cars and bicycles. The island has a quiet anchorage where fishing boats rest at night. One day, we joined a guided walkabout around the harbor and visited a museum about a famous shipwreck. The guide said the lost ship was a navy frigate that hit the rocks in a storm. We also rented a motorbike to explore the coast, but the guide warned us that the island police are strict with speeders. On the flight home, the friendly aircrew gave the children postcards.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我們全家在一座小島上待了一週。我們搭一艘老渡船抵達島上的碼頭，船上也載著汽車和腳踏車。島上有一個寧靜的停泊處，漁船晚上都停在那裡。有一天，我們參加了港口的導覽徒步遊，參觀了一座關於知名船難的博物館。導覽員說，那艘失事的船是一艘海軍巡防艦，在暴風雨中撞上礁石。我們也租了一台摩托車去探索海岸，不過導覽員提醒我們，島上的警察對超速的人很嚴格。回程的飛機上，親切的機組人員送孩子們明信片。

questions.questionZh: 博物館介紹的那艘船是怎麼失事的？

options: 渡船晚上十點以後不開

items.promptZh: 他們搭渡船過河去對岸的市場。
referenceEn: They took a ferryboat across the river to the market on the other side.
They crossed the river by ferryboat to go to the market.
rubricZh: 要用 ferryboat（例如 take a ferryboat、by ferryboat）

items.promptZh: 我爸爸週末都在車庫裡修他的舊摩托車。
referenceEn: My dad spends his weekends fixing his old motorbike in the garage.
On weekends, my father repairs his old motorbike in the garage.
rubricZh: motorbike 指摩托車（例如 his old motorbike 等）
習慣的事用現在式（例如 repairs、spends… fixing 等）
「修」可寫，例如 fix、repair、work on 等
